blocks.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Join a group tour of Tierra del Fuego National Park with an English-speaking guide. You can also book a trip to Martillo Island for a walk among the penguins at $300 per person in a group. The transfer to the port takes about 20 minutes, followed by about two hours on the water. The optional trip is paid for separately.
